title: Encoding a mapped gate list
statement: Let $l$ be a finite list in a type $\alpha$, and let $f$ map each element of $\alpha$ to a directed acyclic Boolean gate. The Boolean string formed from the list of gates obtained by applying $f$ to $l$ is the concatenation, in list order, of a one followed by the encoding of $f(a)$ for each $a\in l$.
hypotheses_covered: Finite list l of elements of α
Function f from α to directed acyclic Boolean gates
